title: David King Over All Israel

questions.question: Who came to David at Hebron to make him king?
questions.explanation: 2 Samuel 5:1 (ESV): "Then all the tribes of Israel came to David at Hebron..."

questions.question: How old was David when he began to reign?
questions.explanation: 2 Samuel 5:4 (ESV): "David was thirty years old when he began to reign..."

questions.question: How long did David reign in total?
Which city did David capture to make his capital?
questions.explanation: 2 Samuel 5:7 (ESV): "Nevertheless, David took the stronghold of Zion, that is, the city of David."

questions.question: Who was king of Tyre that sent messengers and cedar trees to David?
questions.explanation: 2 Samuel 5:11 (ESV): "And Hiram king of Tyre sent messengers to David, and cedar trees..."

questions.question: What did the Jebusites say to taunt David?
options: The blind and the lame will ward you off
questions.correctAnswer: The blind and the lame will ward you off
questions.explanation: 2 Samuel 5:6 (ESV): "...'You will not come in here, but the blind and the lame will ward you off'..."

questions.question: Who inhabited Jerusalem before David took it?
questions.explanation: 2 Samuel 5:6 (ESV): "And the king and his men went to Jerusalem against the Jebusites, the inhabitants of the land..."

questions.question: David became greater and greater, for ______ was with him.
options: The Lord, the God of hosts
questions.correctAnswer: The Lord, the God of hosts
questions.explanation: 2 Samuel 5:10 (ESV): "And David became greater and greater, for the LORD, the God of hosts, was with him."

questions.question: Where did the Philistines spread out when they came to attack David?
questions.explanation: 2 Samuel 5:18 (ESV): "Now the Philistines had come and spread out in the Valley of Rephaim."

questions.question: What did David name the place where he defeated the Philistines the first time?
questions.explanation: 2 Samuel 5:20 (ESV): "...Therefore the name of that place is called Baal-perazim."

questions.question: How long did David reign in Judah alone (at Hebron)?
questions.explanation: 2 Samuel 5:5 (ESV): "At Hebron he reigned over Judah seven years and six months..."

questions.question: What sound was the signal for David to attack the Philistines the second time?
options: The sound of marching in the tops of the balsam trees
questions.correctAnswer: The sound of marching in the tops of the balsam trees
questions.explanation: 2 Samuel 5:24 (ESV): "And when you hear the sound of marching in the tops of the balsam trees, then rouse yourself..."

questions.question: David took more ______ and ______ from Jerusalem after he came from Hebron.
questions.explanation: 2 Samuel 5:13 (ESV): "And David took more concubines and wives from Jerusalem..."

questions.question: What does Baal-perazim mean?
questions.explanation: 2 Samuel 5:20 (ESV): "...The LORD has burst through my enemies before me like a bursting flood."

questions.question: To where did David strike down the Philistines in the second battle?
questions.explanation: 2 Samuel 5:25 (ESV): "And David did as the LORD commanded him, and struck down the Philistines from Geba to Gezer."

key_verse_text: And David knew that the LORD had established him king over Israel, and that he had exalted his kingdom for the sake of his people Israel. (ESV)
